headline: Shopify opens every store to AI agents with Fall '26 Edition, changing how shopping happens
summary: The Fall '26 Edition, 'Exponential', introduces Shop.dev and WebMCP, allowing any AI agent to access Shopify's catalog, cart, and checkout, making all stores agent-ready by default.
details: Shopify's Fall '26 Edition, dubbed 'Exponential', was released on October 28, 2026, featuring over 150 updates. The most significant change is the opening of Shopify's catalogue, cart, and checkout to any AI agent or app, making every storefront agent-ready by default.

This shift fundamentally changes how AI agents interact with e-commerce. Previously, agents had to scrape storefronts, but Shopify now provides structured tools like Shop.dev, offering a single connection to the Shopify Catalog, sign-in, cart, checkout, and Shop Pay.

Shop.dev powers shop.md, a skill that transforms any agent into a personal shopper, enabling search across over a billion products and personalized recommendations. Developers can now build on the same catalogue and checkout used by major agents like ChatGPT and Copilot without needing prior key access.

A quieter but impactful change is WebMCP, now exposed on every Liquid and Hydrogen storefront and checkout. This allows browser agents to search products, update carts, and complete checkout with structured data, meaning all Shopify stores are agent-ready automatically.

Merchants can also connect their stores to nine popular agents, including ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, to manage products, inventory, and orders via a chat interface. Shopify's own assistant, Sidekick, has gained new capabilities like code writing and internet search, always requiring approval before making changes.

For partners, Universal Checkout enables offering a single checkout for products from different brands, handling varied rules and fulfillment logic. This aims to make multi-brand shopping seamless for agents, allowing complex requests like buying an entire outfit from multiple stores.

Underlying improvements include the Catalog API, which now filters for 3D models or video and returns sale prices and safety warnings. The Shopify CLI's AI Toolkit checks apps for common vulnerabilities, and Hydrogen is now generally available with enhanced features like customer accounts and predictive search.
